planSteps.description: Find the password input field and enter 'My-Drop-Site' to unlock the site.
Verify the homepage loads with hero section, featured products, and navigation visible.
Click on the Bridal Gown or Shop navigation link and verify the collection page loads with product cards.
On the collection page, try filtering by color or style. Verify the product list updates to show filtered results.
Use the sort dropdown to sort products by price or name. Verify products reorder correctly.
Click on any product card to open the product detail page. Verify images, name, price, description, and size options are visible.
Navigate to /search or use the search bar. Type a search term like 'bridal' and verify results appear.
Click the About link in navigation. Verify the about page loads with brand story content.
Click the Contact link. Verify the contact form loads with name, email, subject, and message fields.
Scroll to footer and verify all links are present: About, Contact, FAQ, Privacy, Terms, social media icons.
